purpose: Define explicit condition, branch and wait semantics as canonical control-flow constructs rather than arbitrary embedded code.

topics.name: Routine Condition and Branch
topics.purpose: Define explicit condition, branch and wait semantics as canonical control-flow constructs rather than arbitrary embedded code.

semantics.condition_rule: Condition is a machine-readable predicate over explicit bound inputs/state refs.
semantics.else_rule: Fallback/default branch behavior is explicit where applicable.
semantics.wait_rule: Wait may bind to explicit duration, Event, state predicate or other declared wait primitive.
semantics.timeout_rule: Wait/condition loops are bounded by explicit timeout/reentry policy where blocking/repetition is possible.
semantics.purity_rule: Condition evaluation is read-only unless an explicitly separate effectful operation is invoked.
semantics.language_rule: No hidden implementation-language expression is treated as canonical semantics without a declared expression/profile contract.
semantics.trace_rule: Runner execution records the evaluated condition result and selected branch.

invariants.rule: Routine definitions are explicit canonical ordered compositions of exact commands/operations/routines; runtime execution state is never embedded into the reusable definition.

hard_gates.condition: arbitrary hidden code used as canonical condition
condition evaluation performs undeclared side effect
